newsitem.title: USA: PECO boosting Limerick 2 Pa. nuke output.
newsitem.headline: PECO boosting Limerick 2 Pa. nuke output.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,055 megawatt Limerick 2 nuclear power unit, in Pottsdam, Pa., is again increasing power output after reducing to about 40 percent power because of a valve problem.
"They have fixed the problem in the electric hydraulic control system, and the unit is ramping up to about 77 percent power," a company spokesman said.
The unit will likely reach this level sometime Thursday.
The company said it still plans to take the unit off-line January 31 for its scheduled 25-day maintenance and refueling outage.
The adjacent unit, with an identical generating capacity, is operating at full power.
